title: Spain vs England 2–3: Spain's 43-Game Unbeaten Run Is Over 😱 #shorts
description:

title: Cutter Gauthier's 9-Game Goal Streak vs the NHL Record 🤯 #NHL #shorts
description:
Cutter Gauthier of the Anaheim Ducks has scored in nine straight games (as of 15 November 2026), the NHL's longest goal streak in 29 years, with 16 goals during the run. The NHL record is 16 straight games by Punch Broadbent of the Ottawa Senators in 1921–22, and the Ducks record is Teemu Selanne's 11 in 1997. Gauthier is only the fifth player under 23 to score in nine straight games, after Selanne, Wayne Gretzky, Mike Bossy and Babe Dye.

title: Germany vs Netherlands: The Biggest Games in Their Rivalry ⚽ #shorts
description:
Germany vs Netherlands is one of football's great rivalries. West Germany beat the Netherlands 2–1 in the 1974 World Cup final in Munich, Marco van Basten's late goal won the Euro 1988 semi-final 2–1 for the Dutch in Hamburg, West Germany won 2–1 in the 1990 World Cup last 16 in Milan, the Netherlands won 3–1 at Euro 1992 and Germany won 2–1 at Euro 2012. The biggest win is West Germany's 7–0 in Cologne in 1959. They meet again in the Nations League in Berlin on 16 November 2026.
